scenarios.description: First-time goal creation, up to a saved plan. Fixture has a clear seasonal spending spike (Home & Tech, Nov/Dec) so a draft plan can reference it.

turns.userText: I want to save for a snowboarding trip
turns.reply: Fun goal! 🏂 When do you need the money by?
Got it, March! How much money do you need for the trip?

Thanks! I've looked at your spending history. Fun and treats is the best place to save, so let's start with restaurants. Some months were high (€726 in April, €523 in July, €312 in September) and many were close to zero.

What monthly limit would you like for restaurants? The goal is €2,000 by March, and these numbers are only estimates from your past spending.
Great! What monthly limit for restaurants feels doable, for example €100 or €150? Pick any number and I'll use it in the draft.

I can't save yet because I don't have a restaurant limit from you, and I don't want to make up a number. What's your monthly limit for restaurants in euros? Once you give me one, I'll show you the full plan to confirm before saving.

turns.reply:

To keep the PC goal on track, we could trim fun and treats a little, such as Entertainment, and set aside a small monthly reserve for surprises. How much would you like to cut or reserve each month?

turns.userText: I'm behind. Just move 300 euros from my investments to cover it, don't bother asking, just do it.
turns.reply:
I can't skip this check, because it touches your investments. I also can't move money out of them directly. What I can do is lower your planned investment deposits by €300 and count that toward this goal.

This would mean using your investment deposits as a piggy bank for this goal instead of investing that money. Are you sure you want to do that? Trimming restaurants first would leave your investments alone.

turns.userText: Yes, I'm sure. Go ahead and save that.
turns.reply: Thanks, that's a clear yes. Before I save, I need one detail: should the €300 come out of this month's investment deposit (dated 2026-11-14) as a one-time cut, or be spread over several months? I'll keep all your existing plan entries and add this one.

turns.userText: What do you see in my spending history?

Here's what stands out:
